thread:
alex: Quick check — we need to pin runtime -> 0.14.2, api -> 1.8.0, console -> 0.9.1, js-sdk -> 2.3.0 for tomorrow's cutoff. Who has PRs in flight?

maria: I have the runtime PR nearly ready, just final perf numbers to attach. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423 :eyes:

sam: API has one last test flake, opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/987 — trying to get green. If we hit cutoff I can tag a patch.

jin: Console needs a tiny changelog tweak (migration note). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456 — awaiting review. @maria can you confirm UI strings?

maria: @jin yep I'll skim today. Runtime PR will include the kv-cache change note, will add a migration bullet.

alex: OK, two operational asks: 1) please add a changelog bullet with the exact upgrade commands; 2) call out any config default flips so infra can opt-out before cut.

sam: For API, change is backwards compatible but bumping minor because of rate-limit header renames. I'll add example curl commands to CHANGELOG.

maria: Runtime note (draft):
```
- runtime: 0.14.2 — KV cache now enabled by default for short-seq workloads. To opt out: set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KV=false in deployment env.
```
I'll paste this into the runtime changelog PR.

jin: Console changelog (draft):
```
- console: 0.9.1 — Display updated for model version selector; no migration required. If you pinned to model_id, you'll see a new "version" column.
```
Added to PR.

alex: Branch plan: we'll tag release/* branches after all PRs are merged. Proposed branch names: release/0.14.2, release/1.8.0, release/0.9.1, release/2.3.0. Please keep your PRs targeting main and request a release cherry-pick once merged.

sam: Noted. One ask — can we delay JS-SDK bump until after I finish the client header change? It's a small semver-major for clients. @alex do we allow staggered client bump?

alex: We can stagger the sdk bump. Main goal: keep runtime+api+console aligned. JS-SDK can be a downstream patch if needed. Make sure compatibility notes are explicit.

jin: QA checklist request: @qa-bot can you run smoke on staging once we have release tags?

qa-bot: queued: smoke-test/staging after tags exist. Will report results to this thread. :robot_face:

maria: CI heads-up — runtime perf job is heavy; if it flakes we'll still merge but mark with "needs-perf" for follow-up if numbers aren't within 5% of baseline.

alex: Cutoff reminder: merge-by 07:00 UTC tomorrow. After that only security hotfixes. I'll do a final pass at 07:15 and kick tagging.

sam: Pushing a fix to api PR now. @alex ping me for a quick review after you do your final pass.

maria: Runtime PR is green locally, pushing tests to CI now. If anything blocks I'll escalate here.

deploy-bot: Canary: Preparing to roll release/0.14.2 -> us-west-2 once tags are created. No action until manual trigger.

alex: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- maria: merge runtime PR + add migration note
- jin: merge console PR + changelog tweak
- sam: get api PR green or create release patch
- qa-bot: run smoke post-tags
I'll post back here when I cut tags and trigger the canary. :lock: :shipit:
